## University of Arkansas

::: {.university-card .university-card-ua}
### PhD Program in Cell and Molecular Biology

This is the place to summarize your University of Arkansas PhD program. It can stay concise and focused on research direction, coursework, and dissertation milestones.

::: {.content-grid}
::: {.content-card}
#### Suggested structure

- PhD program name
- Research area or lab focus
- Coursework highlights
- Dissertation or milestone notes
:::

::: {.content-card}
#### Good additions later

- One research or lab image
- A short paragraph about your dissertation topic
- A link to your CV or publication list
- A contact or advisor reference if you want it public
:::
:::
:::

### STAT 6393V

Assignments, reports, and presentations for applied statistical learning.

[Open course page](../STAT6393V/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

::: {.content-card}
### Website management

Recommended approach for keeping the whole web presence maintainable:

- keep one canonical source for each page
- use consistent folder names and navigation labels
- publish completed work only
- archive old work instead of deleting it
:::
:::

## Suggested web workflow

::: {.content-card}
1. Keep the homepage short and selective.
2. Put coursework in Quarto so it is versioned and reproducible.
3. Link from Google Sites to the best project pages instead of duplicating content.
4. Review the site structure once per semester and archive old pages.
:::
